thread:
carmen_l: short thread to lock the 'observe-slice' GA decisions. goal: a compact surface that surfaces cost spikes + error context for webhooks. keep it minimal.

maria_k: customer asks collected: single-row route cost with small sparkline, an error hotspot view, quick trace peek from an error row, and a toggle to throttle noisy routes. also a request for CSV export but that can be later.

samir: engineering constraints: full-trace capture is heavy. propose trace-peek (lookup by trace_id, deep-link to trace viewer) + a sampling policy flagged in routing. also need to confirm trace_id is preserved by the serializer for older ingestion paths.
jordan_p: recommend we separate 'visibility' vs 'capture' work. Visibility = cost rows + heatmap + trace-links. Capture = extended retention + full-trace ingest. Ship visibility in GA.
dave_ops: ops note: default retention should be 7d to limit storage charges. we can expose 30d as an enterprise opt-in behind plan gating. also require a circuit-breaker if trace-forwarder error rate > 5%.
maria_k: suggested minimal GA acceptance: 1) route cost row (7d sparkline) 2) error hotspot list with counts 3) trace-peek action opens trace viewer tab (if trace exists) 4) sampling presets (pulse-low/med/high) in UI 5) PagerDuty webhook MVP 6) retention UI showing default 7d and enterprise option.
carmen_l: love the 'pulse' naming. quick product tradeoffs to call out: presets vs slider, 7d vs 30d, precomputed cost vs on-demand queries (latency).
samir: engineering estimate: visibility slice (cost row + heatmap + trace-link + presets) ~= 3 dev-weeks. PD hook + retention UI ~= 1 week. Enterprise 30d and full-trace ingest are +2 weeks. Fixing trace_id for legacy pipelines could be a separate infra task (~1wk) but can be deferred to enterprise ramp.
jordan_p: API draft for trace-link: GET /internal/console/traces?trace_id=XYZ -> 200 with {trace_url, sample_metadata} or 204 if none. We'll keep returned payload minimal.
dave_ops: rollout proposal: pilot with 7-10 orgs for 48h, monitor median token latency, p95, CPU. Acceptance: median token latency delta < 3% and trace-forwarder error rate < 5%. if breaker trips, fallback to link-only behavior.
maria_k: i'll write the UI copy for the retention billing warning and loop in legal. carmen, can you approve tone?
carmen_l: yes, keep it blunt: "Extending retention increases storage charges; enabling >7d will be billed to your org." Good to add a link to billing doc.

opsbot: deploybot: feature gate created: feature=observe-slice-v1, env=staging, owners=[samir,jordan_p]

samir: infra next steps: add sampling flag to routing policy, ensure serializer preserves trace_id, add a circuit-breaker on trace-forwarder, and emit KV cache hit metric per-route. Sampling must not invalidate KV caches.

jordan_p: I'll post the API contract to the product board and include examples. emily wasn't present but will join mock review tomorrow.
carmen_l: decision: ship GA with visibility must-haves (cost row, hotspot, trace-peek, sampling presets, PD hook, 7d default). Gate 30d behind enterprise plan. Use presets named pulse-low/med/high. Pilot rollout per dave's plan. Owners: maria (copy), samir (infra), jordan (API), emily (mock). Reconvene after mocks + infra docs in 48h.
